Financing Arrangements Outstanding borrowings, net of unamortized discount and unamortized debt issuance cost under our current financing arrangements consist of the following (in millions): December 31, 2025 2024 Senior credit facility $ 23.6 $ 778.7 Senior notes 1,443.2 699.0 Less current portion of long-term debt ( 699.9 ) ( 500.0 ) Total long-term debt $ 766.9 $ 977.7 Aggregate maturities of long-term debt subsequent to December 31, 2025, are as follows: $ 699.9 million in 2026 and $ 766.9 million in 2030. Senior Credit Facility At December 31, 2025, we were authorized to borrow up to $ 1.7 billion through a revolving line of credit and committed term loans, pursuant to a credit agreement with a group of banks. The revolving line of credit authorizes us to borrow up to $ 1.0 billion under a five-year term expiring November 2030, and allows us to request an increase in the revolving line of credit total commitment by up to $ 400 million and to request two one-year extensions of the maturity date. The committed term loans authorize us to borrow up to an additional $ 700 million during the six-month period beginning November 25, 2025, and if funded, will mature in November 2028. The applicable interest rates under this agreement are based on either the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR), or a Base Rate, depending upon the specific type of borrowing, plus an applicable margin and other fees. At December 31, 2025, we had $ 26.8 million outstanding on the revolving line of credit, at an average interest rate of 4.62 %, under this agreement. 46 Senior Notes Our senior notes consist of two separate issuances. The first is $ 700 million of 3.875 % senior notes due March 2026, issued in March 2019. Interest payments under these notes are due semiannually in March and September of each year, beginning September 2019. The second is $ 750 million of 4.90 % senior notes due March 2030, issued in March 2025. Interest payments under these notes are due semiannually in March and September of each year beginning September 2025. Both senior notes were issued by J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc., a parent-level holding company with no significant assets or operations. The notes are guaranteed on a full and unconditional basis by a wholly-owned subsidiary. All other subsidiaries of the parent are minor. We registered these offerings and the sale of the notes under the Securities Act of 1933, pursuant to shelf registration statements filed in January 2019 and February 2023, respectively. Both notes are unsecured obligations and rank equally with our existing and future senior unsecured debt. We may redeem for cash some or all of the notes based on a redemption price set forth in the note indenture. Our financing arrangements require us to maintain certain financial covenants and ratios. We were in compliance with all financial covenants and ratios at December 31, 2025.

This discussion contains forward-looking statements. Please see “ Forward-looking Statements ” and “ Risk Factors ” for a discussion of items, uncertainties, assumptions and risks associated with these statements. CRITICAL ACCOUNTING POLICIES AND ESTIMATES The preparation of our financial statements in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles requires us to make estimates and assumptions that impact the amounts reported in our Consolidated Financial Statements and accompanying notes. Therefore, the reported amounts of assets, liabilities, revenues, expenses and associated disclosures of contingent liabilities are affected by these estimates. We evaluate these estimates on an ongoing basis, utilizing historical experience, consultation with third parties and other methods considered reasonable in the particular circumstances. Nevertheless, actual results may differ significantly from our estimates. Any effects on our business, financial position or results of operations resulting from revisions to these estimates are recognized in the accounting period in which the facts that give rise to the revision become known. Certain insurance arrangements include a level of self-insurance (deductible) coverage applicable to each claim. We have umbrella policies to limit our exposure to catastrophic claim costs which may include certain coverage-layer-specific, aggregated reimbursement limits of covered excess claims. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow covers debt service comfortably, with cash generation exceeding reported borrowings by a wide margin. This reflects the capital-intensive but cash-generative nature of the trucking and intermodal franchise, where depreciation is substantial and working capital swings are manageable. The company's scale and diversified service lines support recurring cash inflows even as freight demand normalizes.

Leverage sits well below the sector median, with gross and net leverage both under one turn. Interest coverage is nearly double the sector median, indicating ample capacity to absorb rate volatility. The indicative financial risk profile is minimal, and the company retains substantial headroom before approaching the next leverage threshold.

key_risks.text: The company is substantially self-insured for personal injury, property damage, and cargo claims, with a per-occurrence deductible and aggregate reimbursement limits. Ultimate claim costs develop over time and rely on actuarial estimates, creating potential for adverse reserve strengthening. This is a concrete risk factor disclosed in the filing and could pressure earnings if severity trends worsen.

A large portion of long-term debt matures within the next twelve months, comprising senior notes due in the near term. The company also has a committed term loan available to fund, which if drawn would add leverage. Refinancing risk is mitigated by the revolving credit facility and investment-grade access, but the maturity wall requires active management.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Free cash flow covers a substantial portion of outstanding debt, and the ratio of free cash flow to debt is well above the sector median. This provides a strong buffer for scheduled maturities and shareholder returns. However, capital expenditures are significant and could rise with fleet replacement needs, potentially reducing discretionary cash flow.

Interest coverage is robust, with operating income covering interest expense multiple times over. The company's debt is predominantly fixed-rate senior notes, limiting near-term rate sensitivity. Still, the upcoming maturity of senior notes will require refinancing, and the new term loan, if drawn, could increase interest costs depending on SOFR movements.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer presents a minimal indicative financial risk profile, with leverage below sector median and strong cash flow coverage. The trucking sector faces cyclical demand, but the company's scale and intermodal franchise support resilience. We view the credit as solidly investment grade, with capacity to withstand a moderate freight downturn without breaching thresholds.

Shareholder distributions absorb a significant share of free cash flow, with buybacks and dividends exceeding free cash flow generation. This limits deleveraging capacity and could constrain financial flexibility if earnings decline. However, the company retains ample liquidity and covenant headroom, and we expect management to prioritize debt repayment ahead of discretionary returns if conditions deteriorate.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流足以輕鬆覆蓋債務償付，現金產生遠超呈報借款。這反映貨運及聯運業務屬資本密集型但現金生成能力強，折舊金額龐大而營運資金波動可控。公司的規模及多元化服務線支持經常性現金流入，即使貨運需求正常化亦然。
槓桿遠低於行業中位數，總槓桿及淨槓桿均低於一倍。利息覆蓋率接近行業中位數的兩倍，顯示有充裕能力吸收利率波動。指示性財務風險狀況為極低，公司在接近下一個槓桿門檻前仍保留大量緩衝。

key_risks.text: 公司對人身傷害、財產損害及貨物索賠基本上自保，設有每次事故免賠額及總賠償上限。最終索賠成本隨時間發展，並依賴精算估計，可能導致不利的儲備加強。此為文件中披露的具體風險因素，若嚴重程度趨勢惡化，可能對盈利構成壓力。
大部分長期債務於未來十二個月內到期，包括短期內到期的優先票據。公司亦有已承諾的定期貸款可供提取，若動用將增加槓桿。再融資風險因循環信貸融資及投資級別融資渠道而減輕，但到期牆需積極管理。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 自由現金流覆蓋未償還債務的相當部分，自由現金流與債務比率遠高於行業中位數。這為預定到期債務及股東回報提供強大緩衝。然而，資本開支龐大，並可能因車隊替換需求而上升，或會減少可自由支配現金流。
利息覆蓋率穩健，營運收入覆蓋利息開支多倍。公司債務主要為固定利率優先票據，限制短期利率敏感度。儘管如此，即將到期的優先票據將需要再融資，而新的定期貸款若提取，利息成本可能因SOFR變動而增加。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人呈報極低的指示性財務風險狀況，槓桿低於行業中位數，現金流覆蓋強勁。貨運行業面對週期性需求，但公司的規模及聯運業務支持韌性。我們認為該信貸屬穩健投資級別，有能力承受溫和貨運低迷而不會觸及門檻。
股東分派佔自由現金流相當比重，回購及股息超過自由現金流產生。這限制去槓桿能力，若盈利下降可能制約財務靈活性。然而，公司保留充裕流動性及契約緩衝，我們預期若情況惡化，管理層將優先償還債務而非酌情回報。
